# langfuse_dataset_item (Resource)

Manage a dataset item in a project using project-scoped credentials. Intended for small, curated sets of items that belong in version control; bulk data is better loaded through the Langfuse SDKs. The Langfuse API creates or updates an item by ID, so setting id to an existing item of the same dataset adopts it. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:dataset_item_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_dataset" "support_faq" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "support/faq"
}

resource "langfuse_dataset_item" "password_reset" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  dataset_name       = langfuse_dataset.support_faq.name
  input              = jsonencode({ question = "How do I reset my password?" })
  expected_output    = jsonencode("Use the forgot password link on the sign-in page.")
  metadata           = jsonencode({ source = "help-center" })
}

# A stable ID keeps the item addressable from SDKs and experiments.
resource "langfuse_dataset_item" "refund_policy" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  dataset_name       = langfuse_dataset.support_faq.name
  id                 = "refund-policy"
  input              = jsonencode({ question = "What is the refund policy?" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_name` (String) Name of the dataset the item belongs to. Changing it forces a new item.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `expected_output` (String) Expected output of the item as a JSON string. Validated against the expected output schema of the dataset, if any. Removing it forces a new item.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the dataset item. Item IDs are unique per project across datasets. Generated by Langfuse when not set. Changing it forces a new item.
- `input` (String) Input of the item as a JSON string. Validated against the input schema of the dataset, if any. Removing it forces a new item.
- `metadata` (String) Metadata of the item as a JSON string. Removing it forces a new item.
- `source_observation_id` (String) ID of the observation the item was derived from. Changing it forces a new item.
- `source_trace_id` (String) ID of the trace the item was derived from. Changing it forces a new item.
- `status` (String) Status of the item. Valid values: ACTIVE, ARCHIVED. Archived items are skipped by new dataset runs. Defaults to ACTIVE.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_dataset_item.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${DATASET_ITEM_ID}"
```
